name: srh_admission
description: Cross-implementation RFC 6554 source-route admission vectors: forwarding precedence for in-transit RH3 datagrams and router-level rejection of malformed or non-canonical source routes.
spec: RFC 6554 Sections 4.1 and 4.2; RFC 8200 Sections 4.3 and 4.4; LICHEN spec/05-routing.md Section 8.4; C reference parse_ipv6_dispatch in lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/router.c

verdicts.admit_in_transit: admitted with segments_left != 0: RFC 6554 forwarding precedence, relay to the next segment, never deliver locally
verdicts.admit_consumed: admitted with no in-transit RH3: deliverable at the outer destination

cases.name: udp_no_routing_header
cases.description: Plain UDP datagram without any Routing header is deliverable at its destination.

cases.name: in_transit_two_segments
cases.description: RH3 with segments_left 2 at relay A has forwarding precedence and must be relayed, never delivered locally.

cases.name: consumed_at_final
cases.description: RH3 with segments_left 0 at the final destination is deliverable; the RFC 6554 swap-back keeps grid addresses distinct from the outer destination.

cases.name: degenerate_zero_address_consumed
cases.description: A minimal 8-octet RH3 with segments_left 0 and an empty grid is admitted (the C router admits Routing header lengths down to 8 octets).

cases.name: reserved_ignored_octets_admitted
cases.description: RFC 6554 4.2: the low nibble of the Pad/Reserved octet and Reserved octets 6-7 are ignored when CmprI/CmprE and Pad are zero.

cases.name: hop_by_hop_then_routing_in_transit
cases.description: A leading Hop-by-Hop header followed by an in-transit RH3 is admitted.

cases.name: dest_options_pair_admitted
cases.description: Repeated Destination Options headers are tolerated (only Hop-by-Hop is unique).

cases.name: next_header_none_empty
cases.description: No-Next-Header termination with no trailing bytes is admitted.

cases.name: reject_grid_equals_outer_destination
cases.description: RH3 grid containing the outer destination is rejected (router-level final-address check).

cases.name: reject_grid_equals_source
cases.description: RH3 grid containing the packet source is rejected (forwarding loop).

cases.name: reject_grid_unspecified
cases.description: RH3 grid containing the unspecified address is rejected.

cases.name: reject_grid_multicast
cases.description: RH3 grid containing a multicast address is rejected.

cases.name: reject_duplicate_grid
cases.description: RH3 grid repeating an address is rejected.

cases.name: reject_segments_left_exceeds_addresses
cases.description: segments_left greater than the RH3 address count is rejected.

cases.name: reject_segments_left_gte_hop_limit
cases.description: In-transit RH3 with segments_left >= hop_limit cannot complete the route and is rejected (spec 05-routing 8.4).

cases.name: reject_hop_limit_zero
cases.description: A datagram with an exhausted Hop Limit is rejected before any routing decision.

cases.name: reject_source_unspecified
cases.description: A datagram whose source address is unspecified is rejected.

cases.name: reject_source_multicast
cases.description: A datagram whose source address is multicast is rejected.

cases.name: reject_routing_type_two
cases.description: A Routing header whose type is not 3 is rejected (LICHEN admits only RH3).

cases.name: reject_second_routing_header
cases.description: A second Routing header is rejected: RFC 8200 4.4 processes only the first and layered RH3s create ambiguous checksum scope.

cases.name: reject_misaligned_address_grid
cases.description: A Routing header whose address grid is not a multiple of 16 octets is rejected: this 32-octet header carries a 24-byte grid.

cases.name: reject_four_extension_chain
cases.description: Four extension headers before the upper protocol exceed the bounded embedded profile and are rejected (C router -E2BIG).

cases.name: reject_routing_header_beyond_chain_bound
cases.description: An in-transit RH3 placed beyond the three-header chain bound is rejected, never admitted past unexamined headers.

cases.name: reject_truncated_udp
cases.description: A datagram whose UDP terminal header is shorter than eight octets is rejected (C router -EMSGSIZE).

cases.name: reject_truncated_icmpv6
cases.description: A datagram whose ICMPv6 terminal header is shorter than four octets is rejected (C router -EMSGSIZE).

cases.name: icmpv6_upper_admitted
cases.description: An ICMPv6 datagram (RPL control and diagnostics ride ICMPv6) without a Routing header is deliverable at its destination.

cases.name: reject_cmpr_octet_nonzero
cases.description: A nonzero CmprI/CmprE octet is rejected (LICHEN's profile is uncompressed).

cases.name: reject_pad_nibble_nonzero
cases.description: Nonzero Pad bits are rejected whenever CmprI/CmprE are zero (RFC 6554 4.2).

cases.name: reject_max_addresses_exceeded
cases.description: A nine-address RH3 grid exceeds the eight-hop LICHEN route bound and is rejected.

cases.name: reject_hop_by_hop_not_first
cases.description: A Hop-by-Hop header that does not immediately follow the IPv6 header is rejected (RFC 8200 4.3).

cases.name: reject_second_hop_by_hop
cases.description: A repeated Hop-by-Hop header is rejected (RFC 8200 4.3).

cases.name: reject_fragment_header
cases.description: A Fragment header is rejected: SCHC fragmentation belongs below IPv6 and dual reassembly is ambiguous.

cases.name: reject_next_header_none_with_payload
cases.description: No-Next-Header followed by trailing bytes is rejected: the bytes belong to no protocol and cannot be delivered.

cases.name: reject_unsupported_upper_protocol
cases.description: A TCP payload is rejected: the LICHEN constrained profile admits only UDP and ICMPv6 upper protocols.
